card.name: Age, maturity and experience wording
card.fires_on: Words about being older or experienced, such as experience, mature, oldest, maturity and judgment, in general web text. It also fires on commas or verbs where an older group is about to be named or described.

modes.label: Experience and maturity words
modes.description: Nouns or adjectives that point to life experience, maturity or seniority.
modes.example: Onegin requires<< experience>>, in both ballet and life, from

modes.label: Older group being listed
modes.description: Punctuation or descriptors in lists of age groups, just before older people are named.
modes.example: - Older women<<,>> who looked after the young children.

modes.label: Age comparison words
modes.description: Words like oldest used when ranking members of a group by age.
modes.example: they're found only on the backs of the<< oldest>> termites in the colony.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning elderly, older or aged, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is talking about age, maturity or life experience, and nudges the model toward words like older or elder.
